label: sonnet5
sourceDraft: piedras de shóham y piedras de engastes al efod y al joshen.
spanish: piedras de ónice y piedras de engastes al efod y al pectoral.
grammarChanges: Replaced transliterated calque שֹׁהַם (shóham) with its established Spanish gloss 'ónice', the same licensed sense (H7718).
Replaced transliterated calque חֹשֶׁן (joshen) with its established Spanish gloss 'pectoral', the same licensed sense (H2833).
